item.stem:
[Image: A graph of car production with time on the x-axis and total number of cars produced on the y-axis. Time goes from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. in one hour increments. Total number of cars produced goes from 0 to 400 in intervals of 50. A straight dotted line is drawn on the graph, going from the origin at 0 cars at 8 a.m., to the top right of the graph, at 4:00p.m. and 400 cars. reference_items.stem:
The graph represents the distance and time of a hike taken by Joshua and Liam.

[Image: Line graph of distance versus time]

If they both started from the same place and walked in the same direction, at what time did they meet?
reference_items.figure_description:
A line graph with a vertical axis labeled "Distance (kilometers)" marked from 0 to 5.5 in increments of 0.5 (labeled 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5). The horizontal axis is labeled "Time" with tick marks every 30 minutes from 8:00 to 12:30 (labeled 8:00, 8:30, 9:00, 9:30, 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30, 12:00, 12:30). Two line segments are shown:
- One labeled "Joshua" begins at (8:00, 0) and ends with a solid dot at (12:00, 4.5).
- One labeled "Liam" begins at (9:00, 0) and ends with a solid dot at (11:00, 4.5).
The two lines intersect at time 10:00 and distance approximately 2.25 kilometers.

reference_items.subject: Mathematics
reference_items.stem:
[Image: Two parallel lines, M and N. M lies above N. Two lines are drawn over M and N. One goes up from the left to the right, and the other one goes down, from the left to the right. The two lines intersect N at two different points, but meet at a common point on line M. This forms a triangle between lines M and N. The top angle of this triangle is angle B. The right most angle of this triangle is 70 degrees. The line that goes up from the left to the right intersects line M at a 60 degree angle.]

Lines m and n are parallel.

What is the value of b?

Answer: ____

descriptors: Incorrect (including crossed out, erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

reference_items.figure_description: Two horizontal parallel lines with arrows at both ends are labeled m (top line) and n (bottom line). Two intersecting lines cross lines m and n: one line slopes upward from lower left to upper right, and the other slopes downward from upper left to lower right. The two lines intersect each other at a single point on line m, and they cross line n at two separate points, forming a triangle between lines m and n. The top interior angle of this triangle at the intersection point on line m is marked with an arc and labeled b°. The bottom-right interior angle of the triangle along line n is marked with an arc and labeled 70°. Above line m, in the angle between the right side of line m and the upward-sloping line, the angle is marked with an arc and labeled 60°.

P and Q represent two fractions on the number line above.

P × Q = N.

Which of these shows the location of N on the number line?

options.label: A
options.text: [Image: A numbered axis from 0 to 2 where “P” lies roughly halfway between 0 and 1, “Q” lays roughly three fourths between 0 and 1, and “N” lies halfway between 1 and 2.]

options.label: B

options.label: C

options.label: D

reference_items.figure_description:
The figure above the text shows a horizontal number line with an arrow at the right end. There are tick marks labeled 0, 1, and 2, with equal spacing between 0 and 1 and between 1 and 2. Between 0 and 1, two points are marked with black dots: point P is labeled below the line at approximately 0.5 (halfway between 0 and 1), and point Q is labeled below the line at approximately 0.75 (three-fourths of the distance from 0 to 1).

Each of the four response options shows the same number line with points P and Q in their original positions, along with a third point labeled N above the line:
- Option A: Point N is marked halfway between 1 and 2, at approximately 1.5.
- Option B: Point N is marked between Q and 1, at approximately 0.85.
- Option C: Point N is marked between P and Q, at approximately 0.625.
- Option D: Point N is marked between 0 and P, at approximately 0.25.

reference_items.subject: Mathematics
reference_items.stem:
The table shows the temperatures at various times on a certain day.

| Time | 6 a.m. | 9 a.m. | Noon | 3 p.m. | 6 p.m. |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Temperature °C | 12 | 17 | 14 | 18 | 15 |

A graph, without a temperature scale, is drawn. Of the following, which could be the graph that shows the information given in the table?
reference_items.figure_description:
Four line graphs, labeled A, B, C, and D, each with a vertical axis labeled "Temperature (°C)" without numbers or tick marks, and a horizontal axis labeled "Time" with five evenly spaced tick marks labeled "6 a.m.", "9 a.m.", "Noon", "3 p.m.", and "6 p.m.".
- Graph A: The line begins at a low point at 6 a.m., rises to 9 a.m., rises further to a peak at Noon, drops sharply to a low point at 3 p.m., and rises slightly at 6 p.m.
- Graph B: The line begins at a moderate height at 6 a.m., rises to a peak at 9 a.m., drops at Noon, rises to an even higher peak at 3 p.m., and drops at 6 p.m. to a level higher than the value at Noon.
- Graph C: The line starts at a relatively high point at 6 a.m., drops to 9 a.m., rises to a peak at Noon, drops to 3 p.m., and continues downward at 6 p.m.
- Graph D: The line starts at a low point at 6 a.m., rises to 9 a.m., reaches a maximum at Noon, drops at 3 p.m., and drops further at 6 p.m.
reference_items.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (eighth-grade mathematics).

reference_items.stem:
The graph below shows the humidity in a room as recorded on a certain morning.

[Image: Graph of Humidity in Room]

On the morning shown in the graph, how many times between 6 a.m. and 12 noon was the humidity exactly 20 percent?
reference_items.figure_description: A line graph titled "Humidity in Room". The vertical axis is labeled "Percent Humidity" with horizontal grid lines and markings at 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50. The horizontal axis is labeled "Time (a.m.) in hours" with vertical grid lines and markings at 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, and 12 noon. A continuous curve starts at (6, 5), rises through (7, 20) to a peak at (8, 40), then decreases passing through (9, 30) and (10, 20) to a minimum of about 14 between 10 and 11, then rises passing 20 between 11 and 12, reaching 25 at 12 noon. The curve intersects the horizontal line for 20 percent humidity at three points: at 7 a.m., at 10 a.m., and between 11 a.m. and 12 noon.

In this system, the position of a point P is described by its distance from origin, O, and the amount of counterclockwise turn from a baseline OA to OP. Thus, the coordinates of P are (5, 340°).

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 eighth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it. The state also lists reference items: the calibrated TIMSS items of the same grade most similar to this one (never the item itself or its other parts), most similar first, with their percent correct and their calibrated parameters, each on the scale of its own calibration. Use them to place this item.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 eighth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it. The state also lists reference items: the calibrated TIMSS items of the same grade most similar to this one (never the item itself or its other parts), most similar first, with their percent correct and their calibrated parameters, each on the scale of its own calibration. Use them to place this item.
